title: The Baby Monitor
youtube_title: My Baby Monitor Picked Up Someone Who Wasn't There #scarystories
caption: We don't have a baby anymore. So why is the monitor still on? 😨 Follow for a new scary story every day.
style: dark cinematic digital painting, eerie moonlight, deep shadows, muted blue and amber palette, horror movie still

scenes.text: We sold the crib two years ago. So I don't know why the baby monitor turned itself on last night.
scenes.image_prompt: old white baby monitor glowing green on a dark nightstand, empty bedroom at night

scenes.text: At first it was just static. Then I heard it. Someone humming a lullaby. Slowly. Off key.
scenes.image_prompt: close up of a baby monitor speaker with faint green lights, static in a dark room

scenes.text: My wife was asleep beside me. My son is twelve now, and he was at his grandmother's house.
scenes.image_prompt: a woman sleeping in bed lit by cold moonlight through blinds, man awake staring at ceiling

scenes.text: The camera for that monitor was still mounted in the old nursery. The room we use for storage now.
scenes.image_prompt: dark hallway leading to a half open door, cardboard boxes inside, moonlight on the floor

scenes.text: I picked up the screen. The room was full of boxes. And in the middle of them, the rocking chair was moving.
scenes.image_prompt: grainy night vision view of a storage room full of boxes, a wooden rocking chair in the center

scenes.text: Back and forth. Back and forth. Nobody in it. The humming got louder.
scenes.image_prompt: empty wooden rocking chair in motion in a dark nursery, dust in the air, eerie glow

scenes.text: Then the humming stopped, and a soft voice whispered through the speaker. Daddy, you forgot me.
scenes.image_prompt: baby monitor screen showing a dark room with a small pale shadowy figure behind the chair

scenes.text: We never had a daughter. But this morning, the crib was back in that room.
scenes.image_prompt: old white wooden crib alone in a dusty room in morning light, toys arranged inside, unsettling
